page.metaDescription: Getting started, setup, and usage guidance for BCSentinel and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central.
page.title: From the free scan to continuous monitoring.
page.lead: This documentation explains registration, scanning, result access, Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring as one consistent customer journey.

heroAside.title: Start free
heroAside.text: Run the first scan from the Business Central extension.

heroAside.title: Unlock full analysis
heroAside.text: Assessment opens the existing Full Analysis for seven days.

heroAside.title: Confirm improvement
heroAside.text: Validation enables a new scan after remediation.

sections.title: The recommended flow in six steps.
sections.lead: The free scan comes first; Assessment is not an additional scan credit.

cards.title: 1. Register tenant
cards.text: Register the Business Central tenant, environment, and company and confirm data processing.

cards.title: 2. Test connection
cards.text: Verify API configuration and the registered tenant context in Business Central.

cards.title: 3. Start the free scan
cards.text: Run the first data-health scan and open the limited result preview.

cards.title: 4. Unlock Assessment
cards.text: Open the already generated Full Analysis for seven days.

cards.title: 5. Remediate data
cards.text: Use findings, actions, dashboard, and Executive Report to prioritize work.

cards.title: 6. Validate or monitor
cards.text: Run a new scan with Validation or activate Monitoring for continuous control.

sections.title: Configuration directly in Business Central.
sections.lead: The extension combines registration, connection testing, access, and scan control.

cards.title: Extension setup
cards.text: Manage API URL, registration, and connection in the intended setup area.

cards.title: Refresh access
cards.text: Refresh license and access snapshot before product-related actions.

cards.title: Language
cards.text: German and English are supported using available user and tenant configuration.

sections.title: Free Preview, Assessment, Validation, and Monitoring remain clearly separated.
sections.lead: Each mode has distinct rights, durations, and scan capabilities.

cards.title: Free Preview
cards.text: Limited view of dashboard, issues, actions, and Executive Report.

cards.title: Assessment
cards.text: Seven days of full access to the already generated analysis; no additional scan credit.

cards.title: Validation
cards.text: One new scan credit followed by seven days of full access to the refreshed analysis.

cards.title: Monitoring
cards.text: Scheduled scans, history, trends, exceptions, and full access during the active term.

sections.title: Classify common situations quickly.
sections.lead: Access and scan issues should be checked against the current product state and run lifecycle.

cards.title: No new scan available
cards.text: Assessment does not include a scan credit. A new scan requires Validation or active Monitoring.

cards.title: Tenant not registered
cards.text: Recheck registration, API configuration, and company context.

cards.title: Dashboard remains empty
cards.text: Check scan status, run completion, and the current access snapshot.

cards.title: Report link expired
cards.text: Create a new time-limited share through the intended product path.

cards.title: Wrong language
cards.text: Switch language and reload published content or the local fallback.

sections.title: Important documentation notes.
sections.lead: Content will continue to expand with pilot, product, and AppSource maturity.

cards.title: Does BCSentinel change BC data automatically?
cards.text: The analysis identifies and prioritizes issues. Remediation and business decisions remain under customer control.

cards.title: Is the documentation complete?
cards.text: It reflects the current product state and will be extended with real screenshots, videos, and operating guidance.

cards.title: Where can I get support?
cards.text: Pilot, onboarding, and support requests are collected through the contact page.
